prompt: Cover art for a blog post about fine-tuning a speech recognition model on one person's voice so it understands both tech jargon and Hebrew words dropped into English sentences. Two earlier specialist models (a tech-vocabulary model and a code-switching model) feed into one combined model that does both without getting worse at either. Show the idea visually: sound waves from a speaker turning into accurate text, two streams merging into one, a sense of things clicking into place. Warm, colourful and characterful, with a nod to Israeli street food (the models are named after foods: the combined one is Sabich, a stuffed pita). Leave clear space at the top for a title. Do not try to write a title or any sentences.
structure_checks: two streams visibly merge into one
speech turning into text is legible as an idea
clear space left at the top
any text that appears is real, correctly spelled words; no pseudo-text or garbled glyphs
notes: Descriptive prompt with no exact strings. text_exact passes only if the image contains no garbled or invented text.
